podcast.title: Censorship Allegations by Rage Against the Machine
podcast.body: NBC, as the broadcaster of Saturday Night Live, was accused by Rage Against the Machine of censorship. This occurred after the band's performance on the show was cut short following their protest against guest host Steve Forbes and rumored plans to denounce NBC's parent company, General Electric, for its role in weapons manufacturing and war crimes. "Rage immediately complained of being censored by GE and NBC."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Censorship of Rage Against the Machine (Unspecified Year)
podcast.body: Following Rage Against the Machine's controversial attempt to protest a Republican presidential candidate on Saturday Night Live, NBC security expelled the band from the studio. Subsequently, the entire NBC communication group imposed an absolute censorship and a complete ban on the band's presence. "A partir de ahí ya vendría la censura absoluta y el absoluto borrado de rechagan semacín dentro de todo el grupo de comunicación de la NBC."

srcs.episode: Poniendo en su lugar a Rage Against the Machine
